From: jonas_weber@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deckless commit pulse & risk spotcheck

Team — quick, deckless ask for this morning's submission window. No slide prep required; I want a terse signal and 1-line risk for each high-touch account in your lanes. Please reply inline with the following for any accounts you plan to commit this week:

- Account / ACV
- Current stage (e.g., Negotiation, Legal, Proc)
- Commit signal (yes/likely/no)
- One-line risk (ops/procurement/exec timing/third-party)
- Evidence file name (attach if available)

We'll run a 20-min sync at 4pm PT to confirm rollups and flag any ask-for-credits or escalation paths. If you can't make the call, leave your signal in this thread.

Why deckless: CFO wants a crisp surface of near-term risk without spinning decks — saves time and reduces churn when deals move quickly.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123
